IB/OOB channel mapping and permitted path availability
Protected credentials/TLS-network context and UI field mapping

Capture complete untruncated records and detect duplicates
Stop on ambiguous sensor, path disagreement or malformed/non-numeric reading; do not clear logs

Correlate optional web fields and preserve disagreements

Approve path/UI normalization and allowed tolerance
Review discrepancies and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2272 Wistron-BMC-00957-V002: approve BMC/firmware and exact TEMP_HIB_PEX SDR record ID/entity/name/description, units/linearization/threshold/status and expected operating range/tolerance; define IB/OOB channel mapping, allowed sampling skew and BMC-web field normalization, plus treatment of absent/duplicate/inconsistent records.

review_improvement: Keeps the low-risk full automation while replacing truncated grep/user confirmation with exact cross-path sensor semantics.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPMI sensor names may be truncated or duplicated, and `sensor list` readings omit some SDR metadata. IB and OOB can also reach different controllers or sample at different moments. A reliable check must bind the target by SDR record/entity plus name, retain full metadata, normalize units/status carefully and apply an approved temporal tolerance. The web view is useful correlation but cannot override raw SDR/IPMI disagreement.
